run_id_qualification: Stable handoff label derived from recorded mode and start UTC; original runner did not emit a separate UUID
provenance_chain: Runner checks actual git rev-parse HEAD against EXPECTED before launching subprocess
Full record captures Git tree and clean worktree before launch, actual HEAD and clean status after process exit
Actual Popen.wait return value is zero; process log and 137 XML hashes match the run record
Maven clean removes prior target; raw log records Java21 compilation and full Surefire/Failsafe execution
763 prior input-manifest entries match immutable tested Git blobs, with explicit CRLF/LF conversion where applicable
XML basedir and user.dir agree with recorded workspace; XML properties are corroboration, not standalone Git-SHA proof

build_metadata.qualification: Coordinates identify the artifact, not Git SHA; source binding comes from the chain above

runner.qualification: Copied after execution; raw run record and input/git guards provide execution provenance

publication_policy: Sanitized counts/testcase names/commands/Git objects/hashes only; no raw Maven logs, XML properties, cookies, credentials or environment dump
raw_artifact_access: Original .work logs/XML remain local. Hashes support owner verification; this publication does not make raw artifacts remotely downloadable.
